note: Golden parity fixtures for schema.ts::fingerprintV2. Computed in codictate and copied verbatim to dictation-product-benchmark/tests/fixtures/fingerprint-v2.json. The external harness asserts against these values and must never recompute or overwrite them: a disagreement is a real parity bug, and a fixture that regenerates itself cannot detect one. The payload is FINGERPRINT_VERSION followed by the unique-in-order clipIds, joined by \n, no trailing newline, sha256, first 16 lowercase hex characters.
realFleursDaFirst5Derivation: benchmarks/datasets/fleurs/da_dk/test.tsv, column index 1 (file_name) of the first 5 data rows in the file's natural on-disk order, prefixed with fleurs/da_dk/audio/test/. Natural order rather than the seeded shuffle in benchmarks/scripts/build-manifests.ts, so the external repo can reproduce these five clipIds with head -5 and cut -f2 instead of re-implementing seededShuffle(entries, 42) - which is a Codictate implementation detail and not part of this contract. da_dk/test.tsv has no header row (930 data rows), so row 1 is the first data row.
